Nothing was written on any refused path. THE NEW LARGEST GAP, one seam, one pass, entirely inside P4's row. This destination computes a real per-campaign delivery ledger from the traffic log and no operator surface shows any of it, while the one column that names it prints the opposite. Measured on my own server (8082, /tmp mirror of the working tree, Hebrew locale, the dist built 02:31 with no src/clients file newer): GET /api/clients/campaigns returns for CMP_D001 delivery.available true, sourced_days 1 of flight_days 7, aired {days 1, spots 2, seconds 50.0, rating_points_planned 8.7, spend_ils 6600.0, spots_dropped_by_rule 1}, unknown {days 6, the six dates named, the floor sentence}, as_of.instant 2025-04-27T22:59:00 with its basis, rating_basis and spend_basis caveats, rating_progress {percent 13.38, state floor} and budget_progress {percent 14.29, state floor}. I re-derived the ledger from data/daily_input/Wally_Prime_Reshet_Example_2025-04-27.csv myself: exactly 2 rows for campaign '2023-07 - סנו - סנו מקסימה', 25 and 25 seconds, planned break ratings 4.4 and 4.3, so 2 spots, 50 seconds and 8.7 points, matching data/campaign_delivery.csv (369 rows) to the digit. Across the board: 58 campaigns, 57 flights, delivery available on 51, real aired spots on 44, a rating_progress block on all 58. What the screen does with that. CampaignFlights.jsx:168 renders a hard-coded literal, {'unknown' / 'לא ידוע'}, in the Delivered column of every flight row unconditionally, with no dependence on the payload at all. I opened CMP_D001 on the Campaigns tab and read the DOM: the flight row is '2023-07 - סנו - סנו מקסימה | הדגמה | CMP_D001_F1 | 2025-04-27 to 2025-05-03 | 65 GRP | לא ידוע | עריכה הסרה', one .clients-unknown cell, and .clients-flight-board holds ZERO paragraphs, so the word carries no reason and no path. The reason is not merely elsewhere, it is gone: CampaignFlights.jsx:240-245 and ClientRecord.jsx:255-259 both gate the reason and path_forward paragraphs on !delivery.available, and delivery IS available, and CampaignBoard.jsx:181-182 render those same two strings unconditionally, so with delivery available they resolve to empty strings. Measured on the campaigns tab: exactly two elements matching .clients-basis-note/.clients-basis-path with innerText '' are in the DOM. So the honest empty state the product-wide Bar 3 floor protects (an empty state may become a control with a path forward, never a figure) has degraded into a bare word plus two blank paragraphs. Why this is the largest, on both the laws and the A/B. On the laws: the tri-state is real, unavailable, unknown, and this reports as UNKNOWN a state the product has measured as partly REAL with the six missing days already enumerated and a floor sentence already written for exactly this purpose. campaigns_delivery.py's own docstring says every counted figure is reported as a floor and says so; nothing on screen says so. Two comments in the shipped code now assert something false about the repository they sit in: CampaignFlights.jsx:12-14 ('nothing in this repository observes delivery, so what a flight delivered is unknown, and the reason and the path to supply it are printed under the table') and CampaignBoard.jsx:14-18 ('it refuses to render the third column that surface has, pace, because nothing in this repository observes delivery. The delivery state is a state, not a blank: it names the missing feed and the path that would supply it, on the board and on every row'). Neither the reason nor the path is printed anywhere, on the board or on any row. On the A/B: support.google.com/google-ads/answer/1704396 fetched 200 this round and confirms account, campaign, ad group, ad with the campaign carrying its own budget; P4 matches that containment and beats it on the remedy, but the mechanic a person opens a campaigns table FOR is a row that states what it has spent and delivered against what was booked, and P4 holds 14.29 percent of budget and 13.38 percent of the rating goal for that row, as floors, with the source file named, and prints the word unknown instead. The fix, bounded. Render the delivery state the payload already carries, per campaign, on this destination: the air state (aired, scheduled, unknown days out of flight days), the counted floor with its rating_basis and spend_basis caveats, the named source file, and the floor sentence, so the Delivered cell says at least this much has been counted over 1 sourced day of 7 with 6 days unknown rather than a flat unknown. If the piece holds to its own contract line that delivery is a state and never a figure, then the minimum is still that the state names its own basis: keep the reason and the path on screen when available is true instead of two empty paragraphs, and stop printing the literal 'unknown' over a campaign whose air state is aired. Files: CampaignFlights.jsx, CampaignDetail.jsx, CampaignBoard.jsx, ClientRecord.jsx, all src/clients/**. No backend change is needed and nothing here waits on the owner: decision 4 blocks a live as-run FEED, not the traffic-log ledger P4 already built and already ships in the payload. Correct the two false comments in the same pass. SECOND FINDING, not the blocker, same class as the gap just closed. The weekday coverage line now over-claims in the other direction. weekdayCoverage in both CampaignTerms.jsx:65-75 and OnboardClientFlow.jsx:29-35 prints 'No weekday is selected. Submitting like this is refused' whenever no chip is on, with no reference to the discount percent, while check_weekday_scope returns early when the percent is 0 or blank. Measured: on the amend screen with the percent field empty and every chip off I typed a note and pressed save, the line still claimed a refusal, and PUT /api/clients/campaigns/CMP_D001 returned 200 and saved; POST /api/clients/onboarding with surcharge_discount_percent null, surcharge_weekdays '' and the agency-rule box off returned 201 as CMP_008. So an operator amending only the notes of a campaign that has no discount is told, in both locales, that the save will be refused when it will not. Gate the sentence on a non-zero percent. THIRD, small and carried over: the rollup drill prints per-spot Date and Start time to the second with no time zone declared on the panel, and docs.stripe.com/reports/options fetched 200 this round and states explicitly that the time-zone choice changes both which rows land in the range and how times inside the report are presented. That is still the one mechanic where the reference is ahead.
